reasons.A: Short plain first-person sentences fit, but the stacked fragments ('Not down. Off.', 'I do not skip it.') and the reflective close push the author's clipped rhythm into caricature.
reasons.B: Long, clause-heavy explanatory sentences, hedged and abstract diction ('noticeably', 'less effective'); it lacks the author's terse rhythm and dry asides entirely.
reasons.C: Closest match: short declaratives with some variation, the same mix of first-person narration and plain imperatives, and dry understated asides ('I did not, once, and spent an evening looking') in the author's manner.
